global.health.desc: Get health information about the OpenCode server.

global.event.desc: Subscribe to global events from the OpenCode system using server-sent events.

global.config.get.desc: Retrieve the current global OpenCode configuration settings and preferences.

global.config.update.desc: Update global OpenCode configuration settings and preferences.

global.dispose.desc: Clean up and dispose all OpenCode instances, releasing all resources.

global.upgrade.desc: Upgrade opencode to the specified version or latest if not specified.

tool.list.desc: Get a list of available tools with their JSON schema parameters for a specific provider and model co

tool.ids.desc: Get a list of all available tool IDs, including both built-in tools and dynamically registered tools

worktree.list.desc: List all sandbox worktrees for the current project.

worktree.remove.desc: Remove a git worktree and delete its branch.

worktree.reset.desc: Reset a worktree branch to the primary default branch.
